heading: The backend vtable
text:
## The backend vtable [ISBK.1]

One structure is the whole contract between libds's engine and each of its
series backends ([NSBK.2]). The engine calls nothing a backend has not put
here, and knows nothing about it beyond the identifying fields at the head. It
is libds's internal shape, not integrator contract: an integrator supplies no
backend ([NSBK.2.3]).

Four entry points are **required** -- create per-key state, release it, absorb
a sample, answer a query ([ISBK.1.2]-[ISBK.1.4]). Everything past them may be
absent, and the ABI version in the header ([ISBK.1.1]) is what tells libds how
much of the tail is present at all ([ISBK.1.7]).

An absent optional entry point is an **answer, not an omission**. No stale
sweep means the backend needs no wall-clock eviction ([ISBK.1.5]); no
as-of-now query means reads land as of the last absorbed sample ([ISBK.1.8]);
no clone means an engine holding a live series on this backend cannot be
cloned at all ([ISBK.1.9]). Leaving a hook out states something about the
backend's semantics, so leave it out deliberately.

```c
typedef struct ds_series_backend_vtable {
    uint32_t    abi_version;     /* must equal DS_SERIES_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION */
    const char *backend_name;    /* e.g. "ds-ring-buffer" */
    const char *backend_version; /* impl-defined; part of the replay platform signature */
    uint32_t    atom_field;      /* the backing atom's field number ([ISBK.1.1]) */
    uint64_t    supported_aggs;  /* bitmask of DS_SERIES_AGG_* ordinals */

    ds_result_t (*instance_new)(const ds_series_decl_t *decl, void **out_state);   /* REQUIRED */
    void        (*instance_free)(void *state);                                     /* REQUIRED */
    ds_result_t (*update)(void *state, const ds_slot_value_t *value, uint64_t ts_ns); /* REQUIRED */
    ds_result_t (*query)(void *state, ds_series_agg_kind_t agg, uint64_t window_ns,
                         ds_slot_value_t *out_value);                              /* REQUIRED */
    void        (*evict_stale)(void *state, uint64_t now_ns);                      /* OPTIONAL (NULL ok) */
    ds_result_t (*query_with_value)(void *state, ds_series_agg_kind_t agg,
                         uint64_t window_ns, const ds_slot_value_t *lookup_value,
                         uint32_t k_param, ds_slot_value_t *out_value);            /* OPTIONAL (ABI v2) */
    ds_result_t (*instance_clone)(const void *state, void **out_state);           /* OPTIONAL (ABI v4) */
    ds_result_t (*query_at)(void *state, ds_series_agg_kind_t agg, uint64_t window_ns,
                         uint64_t now_ns, ds_slot_value_t *out_value);             /* OPTIONAL (ABI v5) */
} ds_series_backend_vtable_t;
```
